The German-Malaysian Institute (GMI) was established in 1991 as a joint venture between the Governments of Malaysia and Germany.

It was founded by MARA and the Malaysian-German Chamber of Commerce and Industry (MGCC), with GIZ as an implementing agency.

GMI offers engineering technology diplomas, the German A-Level Preparatory Programme (GAPP) and the GMI-UTP Foundation Programme (GUFP).
